To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

We propose the first public verifiable storage auditing scheme for the integrity of data stored in cloud computing, which allows a third party auditor, on behalf of the client, to verify whether his data are intact without involving the client in the auditing process, while also supporting the most general forms (e.g., block modification, insertion and deletion) of data updates.

(a) we propose a new scheme that enables public auditability and data dynamics for storage security in Cloud Computing; (b) we improve the existing Merkle Hash Tree for data dynamics; and (c) we extend our result to the multiuser setting by using aggregate signature.
we propose an efficient and practical verification scheme for remote data integrity checking in Cloud Computing, which supports public auditability and the most general form of data dynamics.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fundamental problem of ensuring the data integrity in cloud storage.
the fundamental problem of data security in the cloud computing model, which is of great importance in both theoretical and practical aspects.
the problem of ensuring integrity of dynamic data stored in untrusted Cloud Computing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

our work provides the first efficient and provably-secure public auditing scheme with data dynamics for Cloud Storage Security, which is an important building block for the realization of secure Cloud Computing.
we have provided a new solution to the problem of ensuring data storage security in Cloud Computing, which is the first to achieve both public auditability and dynamic data operations.
we provide a new approach to ensure the integrity of the storage data in the Cloud Computing environment, which is highly practical in terms of efficiency and flexibility.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided the first solution to support public auditability for the storage security in Cloud Computing, with full data dynamics.
this work is the first to achieve the seamless integration of public auditability and data dynamics, which are both important features for the integrity protection of data stored in cloud.
we are the first to achieve both public auditability and dynamic data updates in the same storage integrity verification protocol.
The main takeaway from our work is that

it is possible to design a practical and efficient verification scheme to support the integrity of dynamic data in Cloud Computing, which can be of independent interest in the emerging area of Cloud Computing.
, by combining the most general data operations with public auditability, we are able to construct an effective and efficient verification scheme for remote data storage security in Cloud Computing.

, by carefully integrating the techniques from the existing proof of knowledge, proof of retrievability and aggregate signature literatures, it is possible to construct efficient and practical schemes to achieve public auditable and dynamic data storage security in Cloud Computing.
